newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek says earnings could improve in '97.
newsitem.headline: Partek says earnings could improve in '97.

text.p: Finnish building materials and cargo handling equipment group Oy Partek Ab said on Thursday it expected 1997 earnings would be better than 1996.

"The measures taken throughout the group and particularly in Cargotec together with the increase in economic activity will make an improvement in the result possible in 1997," Partek said in a statement with its 1996 results.
"Economic growth for this year appears to be stronger than for last year on most of Partek's market areas," it said.
Partek said Sisu, the vehicle maker it bought in January, would be consolidated at the beginning of May.
"Because of the seasonal fluctuations in activities, the result is not expected to be too good during the first four months of the year," Partek said.
Finnish and Swedish exporters would keep demand for minerals strong and no significant changes were expected in the demand for cargo-handling equipment, the company said.
"Construction activities are also expected to pick up somewhat in Partek's main market areas," it said.
